title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge Regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This helps in reducing overfitting and ensures a unique solution.

title: Why is the solution unique?
text: The addition of the L2 penalty term to the OLS loss function makes the optimization problem strictly convex, which guarantees a unique solution.

title: Understanding the Model
text: The model has $$30$$ parameters, including the intercept. With L2 regularization, the solution is unique because the regularization term ensures the loss function is strictly convex.
